title: Math: Patterns and Chance 🎲
summary:
1. What is a Pattern?
A pattern is something that repeats following a rule. Because it has a clear rule, we call it a Regular Pattern.
• Example (Emojis): 🍎🍌🍎🍌🍎🍌
• Example (Numbers): 2, 4, 6, 8, 10

2. Random (No Rule)
If things are mixed up and have no repeating rule, it is a Random Pattern.
• Example: 🚗⭐🍎🎈🥦 (No rule!)

3. Chance (Will it happen?)
We use these 3 words to talk about chance:
• Always: It happens 100% of the time. (The sun will set tonight).
• Sometimes: It might happen, but it might not. (You will eat pizza for dinner).
• Never: It is impossible. It will 0% happen. (A pig will fly).

questions.questionText: A dog will speak English to you today. Will this happen?
questions.hint: Dogs cannot speak human languages!

questions.questionText: The sun will rise tomorrow morning. Will this happen?
questions.hint: It happens 100% every single day.

questions.questionText: You have a bag full of ONLY Red marbles. Will you pick a Red marble?
questions.hint: If there are only red marbles, you can't pick anything else!

questions.questionText: You have a bag with Red AND Blue marbles. Will you pick a Blue marble?
questions.hint: You might pick a Blue one, but you also might pick a Red one.

questions.questionText: You roll a normal 6-sided dice (🎲). Will you roll a number 7?
questions.hint: A dice only goes up to 6!
